scope: Read-only representation choice completed; this file does not authorize or launch an experiment. One next pilot only; no automatic follow-on.
method: Reachable full-state spatial-target/steer-pedal primitive beam; no local577basis sweep, continuous trim solver, new FD, LP, or learned-model training.
question: Can coupled geometry/steering/pedal transitions from the unchanged reachable launch obtain >=100ms conservative gain at fixed s200 and retain >=80ms total gain at s300 under the existing strict source contract?
hypothesis_limits: No verified one-second opportunity. Passing establishes only source-local improvement through s300, not whole finish, native, pixels, robustness, or a final policy promotion.

start.prefix: Exact current577 holds1..24,96raw unchanged. Reconstruct complete prehold25 checkpoint by one fresh source prefix replay, all96raw charged; verify stored rows/forces/history/tracker/clocks. Do not infer a complete checkpoint from COM pose alone.
start.identity_probe: From cloned prehold25 checkpoint, independently evaluate the factual next hold,4raw; compare every stored state/force/history/tracker/clock field. Any mismatch is a technical hard stop; no repair chain.
start.state: Preserve complete planar state, wheel omega, actual gas, joints/rates, angular and linear momentum, contacts/roads/visited, tracker, time/global raw and launch/tracking histories. Never reset counters or transplant factual poses after a changed action.

actions.enumeration: Lane offsets -0.75,0,+0.75m, each crossed with pedal modes fullgas,coast,brake0.125,brake0.25; then factual saved action for that absolute hold. Exact float32 action deduplication retains first occurrence; skipped duplicates receive no replacement.
actions.geometry: Use existing551 fixed path/project and lap518_control.steering convention. Target station=projected_s+max(7,0.3*COMspeed). Shift target by offset times left unit normal of its fixed path segment; recompute dx,dy. delta=atan(6.48*(-sin(angle)*dy-cos(angle)*dx)/(dx*dx+dy*dy)); action steer=float32(-clip(delta,-0.4,0.4)). Singular target/domain error hard stops.
actions.pedals: fullgas=(1,0),coast=(0,0),brake0.125=(0,0.125),brake0.25=(0,0.25), float32(gas,brake). Hold each action for4raw. No inner lookahead or mandatory greedy backup certification; every actual child raw receives original strict checks.
actions.factual_action_on_altered_state: Ordinary freshly evaluated action only, with no claimed fallback safety.

beam.stageA: One protected factual slot plus at most3 competitive nodes. Advance factual slot by actual source evaluation of its saved command, counted among the13 children; exact tape equality checked every raw. Never rely on adding factual actions alone to preserve the factual path. No cached successor used.
beam.stageB: At most4 competitive nodes from the ONE selected altered stageA full checkpoint. No factual checkpoint transplant/protected baseline slot/cached successor. Factual actions remain ordinary evaluated candidates.
beam.ranking: At each common hold depth, nonterminal children ranked descending fixed-path progress, then descending forward tangent velocity, then lexicographic full action-sequence enumeration IDs. Factual protected slot excluded from competitive selection. Deduplicate only bit-identical full checkpoints including history/clock/tracker/visited; retain first. No approximate COM-only merge.
beam.terminal_selection: Freeze terminal nodes at first forward plane crossing after completing and checking the entire crossing hold. At the fixed depth cap (or no live nodes), choose among gate-passing terminals by earliest crossing latest_s, then largest interpolated COMspeed, then lexicographic action IDs. StageA chooses one terminal and starts B once; no alternative-A restart after B failure.

gates.plane_rule: Same fixed world plane for every offset. Forward sign crossing negative to nonnegative, within +/-10m of fixed station progress and inside original path corridor. Record raw before/after time bracket; linear interpolation of COM velocity for speed. Entire crossing hold must remain strict-safe. StageB begins at completed actual stageA hold checkpoint; all times remain absolute from original source start.

B.gain_definition: original baseline earliest_s - candidate latest_s; total retained gain, not an additional80ms after A

gates.no_crossing: Depth cap does not guarantee reachability. Missing crossing or no gate-passing terminal closes this finite pilot without increasing depth,width,actions,steps or retrying another A terminal.

safety.source_contract: All original577/551 force, launch/tracking prefix clipping, frozen reference+4.85, projection/progress, footprint>=0.5,path<=3,body<100,action-domain and official tracker checks unchanged; use original exact predicate implementations and hashes, not rounded report values.
safety.prune: Force/prefix clipping/reference/path/footprint/progress rejection prunes child immediately; no unsafe child becomes an incumbent.
safety.hard_stop: Body/domain/integrity/cost/IO/hash failure stops entire pilot. No implicit safety relaxation, alternate face, automatic repair/restart, or count reset.
safety.native_observation: Native constructor/reset/step prohibited in this pilot. Source full-state diagnostic controller is not a claimed deployable pixel policy or permission to use hidden state in native evaluation.

verification.rule: Replay selected exact action tape from original source initial state, including96raw prefix and all completed holds. Compare every before/after state, force, histories, visited/tracker, clocks, plane brackets and final full checkpoint. Any mismatch invalidates pilot promotion. Do not replay old incumbent if no new passing candidate.

budgets.attempted_raw_formula: 96 prefix +4 identity +4*13*4*(28+20) search +288 final replay =10372 maximum attempted raw; early preforce failures consume attempt slots even if no completed integration tick.
budgets.reserves: Before expansion reserve a whole4raw child and final288raw verification/20CPU/30wall plus audit10CPU/15wall. Atomic cost journal includes failed raw force calls and preparation. Stop before deadline; no automatic extension.

decisions.A_fails: Close this finite reachable beam representation at this resolution; no claim of global physical impossibility. Preserve577.
decisions.B_fails: First-corner gain does not survive this continuation; close without A restart. Preserve577.

decisions.technical_error: Preserve failing record, charge all calls, stop without repeating search.
